title: Harden SOS/Confessions resources per spec 18.4 (a6qg gaps 1-5)
description: Implement in python/src/lichen: (1) POST /sos must verify Schnorr48 origin signature and silently drop unsigned/invalid (spec/12-apps.md 18.4.1); wire verify_sos_origin() into SosResource POST path. (2) Burst allowance of 2 SOS within cooldown window (spec table 'Burst allowance: 2') — SosResource.check_rate_limit currently rejects 2nd SOS at +1s. (3) 4.29 responses must embed retry_after CBOR payload ({retry_after: 300} for SOS per vector). (4) Rate-limiting must use monotonic time source in production wiring (SosResource and ConfessionsResource default to wall-clock time.time; time_func injectable but production passes none). (5) Add monotonic origin-sequence validator for SOS origin signatures — SosRelay dedups exact (node,seq) only; stale-but-unseen origin sequences must be rejected (vector origin_sequence_rollback expects reject). After each fix, flip the corresponding xfail(strict) pins in python/tests/coap/test_security_app_vector_consumers.py and remove markers once green.
close_reason: All 5 numbered gaps verified LANDED-ALREADY at HEAD (6731bd36dd); no implementation changes were required. Evidence per gap: (1) origin-sig gate in POST /sos wired: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:230-259 (envelope parse, _pubkey_to_iid binding, verify_sos_origin over canonical CBOR core, trust-store TOFU, seq replay gate -> 4.01); landed via 1b478e2847. (2) Burst allowance 2: SOS_BURST_MAX=2 emergency.py:33, period-based evaluate_rate_limit emergency.py:122-163 (2nd SOS at +1s -> within_burst accept); vector burst_second_accepted pins accept=true, matching spec - no vector conflict, no child bead. (3) 4.29 CBOR {retry_after} + Max-Age: emergency.py:261-269, confessions.py:607-613; landed via 88e7b73a22. (4) Monotonic default: emergency.py:93, confessions.py:257, sos_relay.py:97 all default time.monotonic; production wiring passes no time_func so monotonic is used; asserted by test_time_source_defaults_to_monotonic / test_time_source_defaults_to_monotonic_uptime. (5) Monotonic origin-sequence validator OriginSequenceTracker (sos_origin.py:181-208) wired into SosRelay.check_relay sos_relay.py:163-169 and POST/DELETE /sos emergency.py:255-259,314-319; origin_sequence_rollback reject test passes. xfail(strict) pins in test_security_app_vector_consumers.py already removed (no markers remain); fixed one stale docstring claiming sos/medical vectors were xfailed (d085abfc7b). Tests: test_sos_resource.py 107 passed, test_sos_relay.py 50 passed, test_sos_origin.py 18 passed, test_confessions_resource.py 56 passed, test_security_app_vector_consumers.py 94 passed (325 total, 0 failed). ruff format+check clean.
